note: SharePoint list-item capture scope (integrations/capture_sharepoint_lists). It names only lists whose data exists nowhere else: the Vendor Quotes list the Portal's public RFQ form writes vendors' packaging quotes to, on the Portal's fallback site and list ids (plx-customer-portal@31a2623 portal/src/app/api/rfq/submit/route.ts:5,26-33,146-176; RFQ_SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID / RFQ_VENDOR_QUOTES_LIST_ID override them on Vercel: a deployment that sets other ids writes another list, which this scope does not name; which ids production uses is live-unverified). The columns are the fields that route writes; no other column is read. The Portal form lists and the Mission Control mirror lists stay out: they copy systems the Workbench captures. This file grants nothing: the capture principal still needs the live-source audience, and every reader is re-gated per item on the item permissions captured with it. Discovery (coverage audit 2026-10-30): the discover block also captures every list of every tenant site the application may read (libraries, hidden and system lists and every OneDrive left out; a person's list is read only when named here), each with its own columns. Live dry run 2026-10-31 (--discover-only, read-only): 176 sites listed, 53 tenant sites read, 1,282 lists seen, 263 lists found, 236 captured once the 27 below are left out (309 libraries, 710 hidden or system). exclude_lists leaves out the 12 Mission Control mirror lists of the plx-mission-control and plx-mission-control-dev sites (ToDos, Milestone Register, Roadmap, Repo Registry, Risk Register, Projects; Mission Control is captured by integrations/mc_sources). The 15 Portal form and contract lists (PLX Portal - C1..C5 and F1..F10) were left out with them on the premise that the reporting API captures the Portal. Live read 2026-11-01 (scratch, read-only): all 15 listed completely, 0 items each. Every other discovered list is captured; the project registers on other sites stay in.
